column1: # Age-of-acquisition ratings: a verbatim excerpt of Kuperman, Stadthagen-Gonzalez & Brysbaert (2012),
# Age-of-acquisition ratings for 30,000 English words, Behavior Research Methods 44, 978-990,
# doi:10.3758/s13428-012-0210-4; the updated list of 31,124 entries distributed at http://crr.ugent.be/archives/806

# words of this generator (and their lemmas) plus a few spares are kept; every value is as in the source.
# Copied from the CSV of that list bundled in the lftk 1.0.9 package on PyPI (resources/AoA_ratings_kup.csv,
# sha256 eb4a6b4ac5fe8e0eea594fabe1ff6c8507a37a732e2512a380f04a468811f633). Its Rating.Mean agreed with the AoA_Kup_lem
